item.title: What Is OAuth?
item.description:
📝 What is the historical cascade of requirements that got us to this place. We send a secret to a place that only the person trying to identify themselves can access, and they prove that they can access that place by showing us the secret. I consider it one of my biggest successes with OAuth that I was in no way involved in that work.
